app.name: MineMyDinner
app.tagline: Dig tonight's dinner out of your saved recipes and your fridge.

import.title: Import recipes
import.textLabel: Paste one recipe's text, or one web link
import.screenshotsHint: 1 to 5 PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, up to 10 MB each. Images are not stored.
import.batchHint: Separate dishes with a line of ---, or with blank lines. Up to 50 dishes. Links in the file are saved as sources but not opened.
import.pasteSuggestion: This page could not be read. Copy the recipe text from the page and paste it above.
import.batchQueued: {count, plural, =0 {No dishes were extracted.} one {# dish is ready for review.} other {# dishes are ready for review.}}
import.modelNotice: Text, page content, and screenshots you import are sent to a third-party AI model to read the recipe. Leave out personal information.
import.textHint: One recipe at a time. For several recipes, use the text file below and put a line of --- between them.
import.urlHint: One web page at a time. Import several pages one by one.

errors.monthly_cap: This month's model spending cap is reached. Raise LLM_MONTHLY_CAP_USD or try next month.
errors.models_unavailable: No model is available right now. Try again later.
errors.invalid_url: This is not a valid http or https link.
errors.blocked_address: This link points to a local or private address, which is not allowed.
errors.robots_disallowed: This site's robots.txt does not allow reading this page.
errors.fetch_failed: The page could not be loaded.
errors.not_html: This link is not a web page.
errors.no_main_text: No recipe text was found on the page. It may need a login.
errors.text_too_large: The text is too long. Keep it under 20,000 characters.
errors.unsupported_image_type: Use PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.
errors.too_many_items: The file has more than 50 dishes.
errors.unreadable_encoding: The file's text encoding could not be read. Save it as UTF-8.
errors.invalid_parent: The parent entry is not valid.
errors.unknown_ingredient: An ingredient link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.unknown_cookware: A cookware link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.in_inventory: This ingredient is in your inventory. Remove it from inventory first, then change how it is recorded.
errors.has_children: Other entries list this one as their parent, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.used_by_rule: A dietary rule uses this entry, so it cannot be deleted. Remove the rule first.
errors.not_found: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_for_stock_mode: These amounts do not fit how this ingredient is recorded.
errors.self_diner: Your own record cannot be deleted.
errors.several_links: Import one link at a time.
errors.several_recipes: Paste one recipe at a time. For several recipes, use the text file import with a line of --- between them.

review.title: Review recipe
review.empty: There are no drafts to review.
review.unsavedNotice: Drafts are kept only on this page. Reloading or closing it loses them, and they would need to be extracted again.
review.saveFailed: Saving failed: {error} Your edits are kept.
review.allergyWarning: Allergy warning. The recipe can still be saved.
review.allergenConflict: {name} contains {allergen}, which you are allergic to.
review.ruleConflict: {name} matches one of your allergy rules.
review.checkYourself: Allergen information comes from the dictionary and automatic reading, and may be wrong. Go by the actual ingredients and package labels.
review.discardQuestion: Discard this draft? Its paid extraction is lost, and getting it back needs a new extraction.

line.name: Name
line.skipped: Not linked: this line is saved, but its allergens count as unknown.
line.notNeededDone: Not needed: not saved, and planning does not check this cookware.
line.nameConflict: The name “{name}” is the dictionary entry “{entry}”, but this line is linked to “{linked}”.

allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.suggested: A model suggested these. They take effect only after you confirm.
allergens.noneSuggested: The model suggested none. This does not confirm that there are none.
allergens.unavailable: Suggestions are unavailable. You can still choose allergens or leave them unknown.

library.title: Recipe library
library.deleteNotice: Saved menus still show this dish's name. Its ratings and notes are deleted; recipes made from it are kept.
library.noEmbedding: Not yet searchable by meaning; it is retried automatically.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.availabilityHint: Being listed here means you have it. Delete it when it runs out.
inventory.alwaysInStockHint: Assumed to always be at home when planning, so no amount is needed.

people.title: People
people.friendHint: A nickname is enough; no full name is needed. When planning meals, friends' names are replaced with codes such as “Diner 1” before anything is sent to the AI model.
people.deleteFriendNotice: This friend's dietary rules are deleted too. Saved menus are not affected.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.unresolvedHint: The allergens of these ingredients are not known yet. Until you confirm them, dishes with these ingredients are not suggested when anyone at the meal has an allergy.
dictionary.seedNotice: Ingredients you created, which you can edit or delete. Built-in ingredients are under “All ingredients” below and cannot be changed.
dictionary.browseHint: All ingredients, built-in and yours, searchable by name, alias, or category. To change one you created, use “My ingredient entries” above.
dictionary.deleteIngredientNotice: {count, plural, one {# dish uses it} other {# dishes use it}}. After deleting, those lines become unlinked and their allergens count as unknown.
dictionary.deleteCookwareNotice: {count, plural, one {# dish needs it} other {# dishes need it}}. After deleting, those dishes no longer record that they need it.
